An alternative interpretation would merge חִפּוּשׂ into Package 1 (since the searching is done via the candles), but this would violate the bechina/eitza distinction: the candles ENABLE the searching (eitza), they are not the SAME THING as the searching (that would require a bechina statement equating חִפּוּשׂ with נרות, which does not appear in the text).

PACKAGE 1 — נֵר הַנְּשָׁמָה וְהַמִּצְוו‍ֹת (The Candle of the Soul and the Mitzvot):
This is a three-node bechina cluster meeting the 3+ threshold for a standalone package. The Rebbe equates: (1) מצוות with נרות ('הַמִּצְוו‍ֹת הֵם נֵרוֹת', anchored in 'נֵר מִצְוָה' of Proverbs 6:23); and (2) נשמת אדם with נר ('נֵר ה' נִשְׁמַת אָדָם', Proverbs 20:27, used as the Talmudic proof-text for Pesachim 10b's rule that searching requires candles). The three nodes form a connected chain: נשמה ↔ נר ↔ מצוה. All three are the same thing seen from different angles — the luminous capacity for spiritual discovery that permeates the holy soul, the performed commandment, and the candle all share the same essential nature.

PACKAGE 2 — חָפְשִׁי וְהַחִפּוּשׂ (Freedom and Searching):
This is a 2-node cluster, below the 3+ preferred threshold but containing an explicit bechina equation. The Rebbe states: 'חָפְשִׁי, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת הַחִפּוּשׂ.' These represent a distinct domain: the post-mortem spiritual state of the soul, where freedom-from-obligation and active-searching are revealed as identical. This domain is separate from Package 1 (which describes the nature of the tools — mitzvot/candles/soul), whereas Package 2 describes the nature of the activity/state.

EITZA STRUCTURE BETWEEN PACKAGES:
Package 1 → eitza → Package 2: The mitzvot-as-candles (Package 1) ENABLE the searching (Package 2). The candle does not share essential nature with the searching; it makes the searching possible. This is a clean eitza relationship between the two packages.

This is not stated with bechina language — it is presented as an exceptional case within the same framework (eitza: self-mortification → living access to divine searching). No new package is implied.
